d: Shenzhen hosts the APEC Summit 2026 on November 18-19 where US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping hold a historic trilateral meeting to discuss global peace, Ukraine war resolution, Middle East tensions and economic issues. Known as China’s Silicon Valley and AI Wonderland, Shenzhen has transformed from a fishing village into a futuristic smart city filled with delivery drones, driverless taxis and humanoid robots, yet faces hidden challenges of automation-driven job losses, real estate crisis, gig economy struggles and stark…
